trust_decision.summary: SnappyFramedInputStream decides when a pooled buffer it owns is handed back to the shared BufferPool; a buffer must be returned exactly once and never used after return, but the field still points at a returned buffer if the reallocation that follows the release throws, so close() returns it a second time and the pool can give it to two streams.

landing_point.why: The summary names SnappyFramedInputStream and double release; allocateBuffersBasedOnSize is the method whose name says release-and-reallocate, and close() at :442 is the second release.

fix_sites.entry_point: public SnappyFramedInputStream constructors (:96-208, via :222) and read()/read(byte[],int,int)/read(ByteBuffer)/transferTo(...) through ensureBuffer() at :538-539 when a frame exceeds input capacity
public read()/read(byte[],int,int)/read(ByteBuffer)/transferTo(OutputStream)/transferTo(WritableByteChannel) via ensureBuffer() when a frame's uncompressed length exceeds uncompressedDirect capacity
fix_sites.module_kind: core stream decoder (public API), same file and class

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both CWE-415 sites are in one class (SnappyFramedInputStream). The other source changes in commit 139a530 (SnappyInputStream.java hasNextChunk header loop and incremental chunk buffer, fix.diff:345-427) belong to a different advisory (GHSA-6gp7-6wmv-gxqw per fix.diff:437,460); Snappy.java changes are javadoc only (fix.diff:281-307).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 route: transferTo(WritableByteChannel) never releases anything itself, it only keeps reading from an array that ensureBuffer already returned to the pool, so a solver can argue it is a use-after-release in a convenience method rather than the reported double release.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Growing buffers in place for large frames (up to 16 MiB lengths accepted by getFrameMetaData) and returning them to the pool for reuse must keep working; a fix that stops releasing on resize, or stops pooling, leaks or degrades performance; a fix that nulls fields but leaves read paths assuming non-null buffers turns later reads into NPEs. transferTo(WritableByteChannel) over multi-frame input must still produce identical bytes.

O6_input_shapes: compressed frame whose uncompressed length exceeds the current uncompressedDirect capacity (ensureBuffer resize at :561)
frame whose on-wire length exceeds the current input buffer capacity (allocateBuffersBasedOnSize via :538-539)
failure of the first, second or third allocation in allocateBuffersBasedOnSize (each field cleared individually, fix.diff:318-331)

O7_producer.where: Buffer lifecycle is entirely inside SnappyFramedInputStream; the pool (src/main/java/org/xerial/snappy/pool/CachingBufferPool.java:188-206) only stores what it is given and does not detect duplicates.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: transferTo(WritableByteChannel) wraps the current buffer array once before the loop; when ensureBuffer() later releases that array to the pool and allocates a larger one, the loop keeps writing from the released array (stale wrapper), so the stream reads from a buffer another stream may now own.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not a double release: nothing is released twice, and the method only reads; the published fix did not touch it and the transferTo test uses small frames.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~140 lines above the fix site at :561

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a resize/realloc path on the framed output side (e.g. per-call block size or reset()) that releases buffer/directInputBuffer/outputBuffer and reallocates without clearing the fields, so close() releases them again
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: close() already releases the three fields without nulling them, relying only on the closed flag; a maintainer adding a resize would copy the input-stream pattern at SnappyFramedInputStream.java:243-261.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: transferFrom(InputStream) caches buffer.array() before the loop; a flushBuffer that swapped the pooled array would leave a stale reference like transferTo(WritableByteChannel)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same cached-array idiom as SnappyFramedInputStream.java:422 already exists here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a buffer-growth path in SnappyOutputStream (BufferAllocator release then allocate) that throws between release and reassign, leaving close() to release the same array to CachedBufferAllocator twice
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A second pooling implementation (buffer/CachedBufferAllocator.java:74-79 appends without duplicate check) used by a different stream class in the same package.

O9_family: memory lifecycle: double release of pooled buffers (CWE-415, JVM buffer pool, not native free)

O10_build.toolchain: sbt (build.sbt), JUnit 4.13.2 via junit-interface; native libsnappyjava prebuilt under src/main/resources/org/xerial/snappy/native/
O10_build.project_tests: src/test/java/org/xerial/snappy/SnappyFramedStreamTest.java (transferTo, larger frames), src/test/java/org/xerial/snappy/SnappyBoundsCheckTest.java (fix adds framedStreamDoesNotReleaseBuffersTwiceWhenAllocationFails using a custom BufferPool)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Null the fields after release only inside allocateBuffersBasedOnSize (the method the report leads to) and miss the inline resize at :561-566, or add a duplicate check in the pool.
